_source: Written by Claude from facial action unit (FACS) knowledge. The paper used ChatGPT-3.5, so this is a reproduction difference.
_query: What are the most useful visual features to distinguish the facial expression of [class]?

descriptions.surprise: raised curved eyebrows, horizontal forehead wrinkles, wide open eyes showing white above the iris, dropped jaw with an open relaxed mouth
descriptions.fear: eyebrows raised and pulled together, wide open eyes with tensed lower eyelids, lips stretched horizontally toward the ears, slightly open mouth
descriptions.disgust: wrinkled nose, raised upper lip, lowered eyebrows, narrowed eyes, raised cheeks, lower lip pushed up or turned down
descriptions.happiness: a smiling mouth with raised lip corners, raised cheeks, wrinkled eyes with crow's feet, arched eyebrows, often visible teeth
descriptions.sadness: inner corners of the eyebrows raised and pulled together, drooping upper eyelids, lip corners pulled down, raised chin, downcast gaze
descriptions.anger: eyebrows lowered and pulled together, vertical wrinkles between the brows, glaring eyes with tense eyelids, lips pressed tightly or open showing teeth, flared nostrils
descriptions.neutral: relaxed eyebrows in resting position, normally open eyes, closed relaxed lips, no wrinkles on the forehead or nose, calm symmetrical face
